gaps.sentence: ___ you finish early, come and give us a hand.
gaps.explanation: 'If' introduces a real condition; 'in case' would change the meaning to precaution.

gaps.sentence: I enjoyed the film; the ending was weak, ___.
gaps.explanation: 'Though' can come at the end of a sentence as a casual contrast marker; the others cannot.

gaps.sentence: I'll tell you everything ___ you promise to keep it between us.
gaps.explanation: 'As long as' sets the condition attached to the promise.

gaps.sentence: ___ a staffing shortage, the clinic closed early.
gaps.explanation: 'Due to + noun phrase' states the cause in formal register.

gaps.sentence: The lecture was dull; ___, the students stayed awake out of politeness.
They behaved ___ nothing at all had happened.
gaps.explanation: 'As if + past perfect' signals that the comparison is contrary to fact.

gaps.sentence: Please complete the form in block capitals ___ it can be read easily.
gaps.explanation: 'So that' introduces a clause with subject and modal; so as to/in order to need an infinitive.

gaps.sentence: The essay was submitted late and, ___, it ignored the brief entirely.
gaps.explanation: 'What is more' adds a further, stronger point to an already negative picture.
